description: This file contains utility functions for making API requests, including error handling, URL construction, response parsing, and abort signal management. It defines an API request function for interacting with a backend REST API in a frontend application.

methods.name: makeApiError(operation, message, status, details)
methods.description: Creates a structured error object with details about the API error for debugging purposes.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Determines the base URL for API requests, either from environment variables or defaults to localhost.

methods.name: parseResponseBody(res)
methods.description: Parses the response body as JSON if content-type indicates JSON, otherwise as text, with error handling.

methods.name: makeAbortSignal(signal, timeoutMs)
methods.description: Creates an AbortSignal that combines a timeout with an optional external signal, with fallback for environments without AbortSignal.any/timeout.

methods.name: apiRequest(operation, path, options = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the backend API, handling URL construction, headers, body, error handling, and response parsing. It returns a promise resolving to a success or error object.
